## Failure mode or adoption need

Describe the concrete problem this change addresses.

## Enforcement site

- [ ] Mechanical invariant
- [ ] Separate-instance review
- [ ] Primary-source or governed-object check
- [ ] Writer self-discipline only, with justification

## Change class

- [ ] Core specification
- [ ] Checker
- [ ] Recommended practice
- [ ] Field report
- [ ] BAION-specific example

## Verification

- [ ] A failing fixture or reproducer is included when practical.
- [ ] Tests cover the corrected path.
- [ ] `./verify_repo.sh` passes.
- [ ] Normative and non-normative language remain separated.
- [ ] No private or unpublished material crossed the publication boundary.
- [ ] The change does not imply that structural conformance proves factual truth.
